title: Zesty, Gooey Dutch Poffertjes Wrap
description: Indulge in the rich flavors of the Netherlands with this earthy, gooey, and vegetarian-friendly Dutch dish wrapped in a pandan leaf.

ingredients.name: Poffertjes batter (see below for recipe)
ingredients.notes: Note: You can make this batter from scratch or use store-bought mix.

instructions: Preheat your ttukbaegi earthenware pot to 375°F (190°C) for at least 10 minutes before use.
In a large bowl, whisk together the poffertjes batter, granulated sugar, and cinnamon.
Add the unsalted butter, vanilla extract, large eggs, and whole milk to the bowl. Whisk until the batter is smooth and free of lumps.
Using a piping bag or a spoon, pipe or drop the batter into the preheated ttukbaegi earthenware pot, filling it about 2/3 full.
Cook the poffertjes for 5-7 minutes, or until they are golden brown and fluffy.
Dust the cooked poffertjes with powdered sugar.
Warm the pandan leaf wraps according to package instructions.
To assemble the wrap, place a few cooked poffertjes in the center of the pandan leaf wrap.
Drizzle with a little bit of honey or maple syrup, if desired.
Repeat the process to create multiple wraps, and serve immediately.
